# FinWise Personal Finance Documentation Index
> Autonomous Personal Finance Intelligence Platform and API Reference

## Core Architectural Guides

- [BUILDING_ON_THIS_PROJECT](BUILDING_ON_THIS_PROJECT.md): 25 end-to-end full-stack feature recipes and blueprints.

- [API](docs/API.md): Canonical /api/v1 REST endpoints and real-time SSE streams.
- [AI_CORE](docs/AI_CORE.md): LangGraph DAG, SubAgentManager, KeyPool, and continuous canary validation.
- [DATABASE](docs/DATABASE.md): 52 Mongoose models, compound B-tree indexes, and GridFS storage.
- [SERVICES](docs/SERVICES.md): Comprehensive directory of 60+ domain business logic services.
- [FRONTEND](docs/FRONTEND.md): FinanceOS 5-surface cockpit, Zustand state stores, and UI atlas.
- [SECURITY](docs/SECURITY.md): Defense in depth, CSRF protection, and SSRF prevention.
- [DEPLOYMENT](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md): Docker Compose multi-tier orchestration and cloud readiness.
- [CHANGELOG](docs/CHANGELOG.md): Semantic version history and release notes.
